summary: ROUND 6A.2c Addendum 'Invia Squadra' reverse UX flow — frontend e2e validated end to end. 21/21 assertions passed across all 7 functional features.

issues: React hydration warning in dev console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — Emergent dev tracker injects <span style=display:contents> inside <option> at ExpeditionNew.jsx:288 (and similarly RaidBuilder.jsx:346). Likely DEV-only annotation, not runtime, but generates console error noise. Worth confirming it disappears in production build.

R20 squad with missing=20 renders <button disabled> with tooltip '20 adventurers missing, edit the squad' and label 'Launch Raid'. (Enabled raid_20 link path not directly exercised — no 20/20 squad seeded; structural code path verified by /raids builder link test.)

feature_results.F3_start_link_propagation: PASS — start-dungeon-<slug> Link's wrapping <a> includes ?squad_id=<id>; navigation to /dungeons/<slug>/start triggers autoload effect. Selected count came back 0/3 because the seeded D3 squad has all 3 adventurer_ids missing from live roster (missing=3). This is correct behavior — autoload toasted partial-match warning and left selection empty. Not a bug.
feature_results.F4_raids_squad_context: PASS — raids-squad-banner shows, raid-builder-link-<slug> href includes ?squad_id=<id>, raids-squad-clear strips squad_id.

Live grid population not asserted because the seeded R20 squad has all 20 missing. Recommend main agent seed a complete raid_20 squad to fully validate.
feature_results.F6_reload_persistence: PASS — F5 reload on /dungeons?squad_id=<id> still shows banner; URL retains squad_id.
feature_results.F7_invalid_squad_id: PASS — nonexistent_id removed via setSearchParams({}, {replace:true}); banner absent. Cross-type guard: passing raid_20 squad_id to /dungeons triggers 'Questa squadra è per raid (20), usa /raids' toast (visible in screenshot) and clears the param.
feature_results.F8_lint_gate: NOT RE-RUN — already validated by main agent per request.

critical_code_review_comments: Squads.jsx SquadCard.deployDisabled logic is correct (isRaid && missing>0). Tooltip i18n covers both IT/EN.
Dungeons.jsx useEffect on squadIdParam properly cancels with 'cancelled' flag and uses setSearchParams({}, {replace:true}) — good URL hygiene.
Raids.jsx uses GET /api/squads?type=raid_20 (server-side filter) which is more efficient than client filter used by Dungeons.jsx (which fetches all). Minor inconsistency, not a bug.
Both ExpeditionNew and RaidBuilder use autoLoadedRef pattern to prevent re-autoload loop — solid.

Cross-type guard (raid_20 squad on /dungeons) lives only in Dungeons.jsx; Raids.jsx already filters by type=raid_20 server-side so dungeon squads simply yield 'not found' toast — semantically consistent.
